$comment:
================================================================================
AIRLOCK CONTRACT: IncidentHandoffEnvelope v1.2.0
Governs the boundary between Upstream Triage and Autonomous Agent Investigation.
Enforces Invariant #2 (Cognitive Anti-Anchoring) and the Bounded Query Perimeter.
================================================================================
title: IncidentHandoffEnvelope

schema_version.$comment: Pins the contract version. Must be strictly 1.2.0 to ensure schema compatibility.

tenant_id.$comment: Multi-tenancy isolation anchor: UUID representing the enterprise customer organization.

incident_cluster_id.$comment: Unique identifier for this specific correlated attack cluster across telemetry sources.

routing_lane.$comment: Determines investigation priority and timeout budgets (e.g. 480s for expedited).

timestamps.$comment: Audit trail timestamps tracking the alert lifecycle from raw wire arrival to agent handoff.

ingestion_timestamp_utc.$comment: When the first raw alert in this cluster was received by triage gateway.

clustering_window_start_utc.$comment: Start time of the correlation graph aggregation window.

clustering_window_end_utc.$comment: End time of the correlation graph aggregation window.

handoff_timestamp_utc.$comment: Timestamp when Upstream Triage signed and dispatched the handoff envelope.

source_alert_ids.$comment: Raw alert IDs from external SIEM/EDR systems that were correlated into this single cluster.

normalized_ocsf_events.$comment: Telemetry normalized into standard OCSF v1.3 JSON objects (Process, Network, Authentication).

graph_blast_radius.$comment: In-memory Memgraph blast-radius output: affected nodes, asset tier (Tier 0-3), and degree centrality.

identity_context.$comment: Active Directory / IdP context for users involved (roles, groups, privilege tier).

process_lineage.$comment: Process execution trees (e.g., winword.exe -> powershell.exe -> whoami.exe).

lookback_windows_applied.$comment: Domain-specific historical lookback depths (e.g. 72h for email, 24h for auth, 7d for DNS).

enrichment_status.$comment: Threat intelligence lookups: domain age, IP reputation, VirusTotal hashes, OOB challenge logs.

sanitization_truncation_flags.$comment: AIOpsShield sanitizer metrics: count of scrubbed credentials, stripped ANSI codes, and field clamps.

query_perimeter.$comment: SAFETY GUARDRAIL (Fix 8): Defines the strict perimeter fence for investigation agents. Agents (Investigative Executor) are physically refused if they attempt SIEM queries outside these target hosts, users, or time window.
query_perimeter.description: Proposed bounding perimeter for Investigative Executor queries populated by triage gateway; queries outside scope are refused

target_hosts.$comment: Specific hostnames the agents are permitted to query forensic evidence for.

target_users.$comment: Specific usernames the agents are permitted to query forensic evidence for.

lookback_window_start_utc.$comment: Earliest allowable timestamp for agent forensic queries.

lookback_window_end_utc.$comment: Latest allowable timestamp for agent forensic queries.

evaluation_metadata.$comment: INVARIANT #2 (COGNITIVE ANTI-ANCHORING): Holds Upstream Triage mathematical risk metrics. Must be withheld from LLM agent prompts so agents reason independently from raw facts rather than anchoring on upstream triage score.
evaluation_metadata.description: NON-EVIDENTIARY: Withheld from reasoning agent prompts to eliminate anchoring bias

non_evidentiary_for_agents.$comment: MUST BE TRUE: Invariant assertion flag guaranteeing this block is stripped before agent prompt generation.

s_score.$comment: Non-conformity score s(X) in [0.0, 1.0] calculated via Conformal Deferral.

theta_low.$comment: Lower conformal threshold: alerts below this are candidates for auto-close (post-sleep mode).

theta_high.$comment: Upper conformal threshold: alerts above this route to expedited machine-speed priority.

aact_action_rate.$comment: Dynamic Action Frequency: historical baseline execution rate for this alert type.

aip_rarity_score.$comment: Adaptive Incident Prioritization rarity score based on tenant-specific prevalence.

transport_security.$comment: AUTHENTICITY & ANTI-REPLAY: Cryptographic proof that this envelope was authored by the genuine triage gateway.

nonce.$comment: Single-use UUID to prevent replay attacks.

sent_at.$comment: Transmission timestamp; evaluated by the receiver to reject skewed packets (>10s clock skew).

signature.$comment: Digital signature created using the gateway's private key.

signer_identity.$comment: Authorized signing service identity. Only these two authorized system entities are permitted.

cadence_profile.$comment: OPTIONAL MACHINE-CADENCE BLOCK: Present only when an active machine-speed attack burst is detected.
cadence_profile.description: Optional: present only when CADENCE_MACHINE_SPEED is detected

ingress_vector.$comment: Attack entry point classification. Determines precautionary hold routing.

origin_ip.$comment: Source IP address triggering the burst.

subject_entity_id.$comment: ID of the target host or account experiencing the attack burst.

observed_identities.$comment: Accounts targeted or observed during the attack burst.

detection_timestamp.$comment: Timestamp when cadence velocity threshold was breached.

evidence_summary.$comment: Underlying cadence metrics: command retry velocity and lateral graph edge creation rate.

primitive_a_retries.$comment: Primitive A: Count of rapid CLI command-line retries with small edit distance.

primitive_b_new_edges.$comment: Primitive B: Count of new graph edges created within the lateral movement window.

overflow_fanout_count.$comment: Graph degree fan-out count exceeding the baseline threshold.

corroborating_rule.$comment: Independent rule verifying the cadence detection (Anti-Circularity Invariant).

non_evidentiary_for_agents.$comment: Withheld from agents to preserve independent analysis.
